other_resources.note: Created by default (create_parameter_group = true, variables.tf:261) with family var.family = "redis7" (variables.tf:50). findings.title: redis 7.0 is supported; Valkey recommended for cost
findings.description:
aws_elasticache_replication_group runs redis 7.0 (set at examples/complete/fixtures.us-east-2.tfvars:20; engine_version = "7.0" -> examples/complete/main.tf:56 (var.engine_version) -> main.tf:185 (local.engine_version). engine defaults to "redis" (variables.tf:65). Replication group id resolves to eg-test-redis-test-<random> (terratest).) Status: SUPPORTED - Supported. Optional: move to Valkey to cut cost. Source: AWS documentation (live data, AWS Health and Trusted Advisor not read because live_access=off). Risk Medium (score 3): Single-node cluster (cluster_size = 1, num_cache_clusters = 1) with automatic_failover_enabled = false (+2, examples/complete/fixtures.us-east-2.tfvars:16); CI runs terraform apply without plan review (Terratest InitAndApply/Apply uses -auto-approve, triggered by /terratest chatops) (+1, test/src/examples_complete_test.go:37). No blockers: resource is a replication group/serverless cache and in-transit encryption is enabled (transit_encryption_enabled default true, variables.tf:83; serverless always uses TLS). Recommendation rule 3: valkey-9 9.1. Alternatives: Valkey 8, Valkey 7.2 (in-place rollback to Redis OSS 7.1), Redis OSS 7.1. Confirm the newest Valkey version in us-east-2 with DescribeCacheEngineVersions before applying. Extended Support exposure: none (estimate).

findings.title: Live data unavailable (live_access=off)
findings.description: live_access=off was set in the plan context, so no AWS credentials were used and no describe calls were made. Live engine versions, node types, topology, Global Datastore membership and drift could not be checked; live_data=unavailable in every plan block. Unmanaged live caches (not in IaC) cannot be detected. Rerun with live_access=auto and a read-only role (elasticache:Describe*, elasticache:ListTagsForResource, health:Describe*, support:DescribeTrustedAdvisor*, sts:GetCallerIdentity) to confirm.

findings.title: AWS Health events not read
findings.description: AWS Health ElastiCache lifecycle events were not read (live_access=off). Lifecycle status was taken from AWS documentation (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/extended-support-versions.html).

findings.title: Trusted Advisor findings not read
findings.description: ElastiCache-related Trusted Advisor checks were not read (live_access=off).

findings.title: Redis parameter group (family redis7) tied to the cache engine
findings.description: Created by default (create_parameter_group = true, variables.tf:261) with family var.family = "redis7" (variables.tf:50). Only dynamic parameter notify-keyspace-events in examples/complete (plus static cluster-enabled when cluster mode is on). A remediation to Valkey must switch the family (valkey9/valkey8/valkey7) and carry these values over.

findings.title: Optional Global Datastore membership (global_replication_group_id)
findings.description: global_replication_group_id defaults to null (variables.tf:339) and no example sets it, so no Global Datastore is configured in this repository. A downstream caller that sets it would hit the Global Datastore blocker (secondary Regions upgrade first; parameter group managed globally).

findings.title: Valkey targets need in-transit encryption; module default is enabled
findings.description: transit_encryption_enabled defaults to true (variables.tf:83) and examples/complete sets it true (fixtures.us-east-2.tfvars:24). A downstream caller that sets it to false would hit the in-transit encryption blocker for Valkey targets (enable TLS with transit_encryption_mode = preferred then required, or choose Redis OSS 7.1).
